rationale: MNB Payment Systems Report is a recurring regulator series with POS/acquirer/qvik baselines — durable monitored source.
One-off 2019 GVH card-acceptance inquiry PDF — high-value evidence on acquirer shares, not a producing feed.
GIRO instant-payment/qvik participant pages are an authoritative, refreshed roster of live HU PSPs.
Ecommerce Hungary is both a member directory to mine and an ongoing news/event source for merchant-side payments.
Kosarertek.hu is an active HU e-commerce trade portal with PSP company profiles and partnership news.
Gateway partner directory is a one-time map of connectable HU acquirers/methods; low change velocity.
K&H merchant qvik docs are useful for bank-by-bank capability benchmarking but URL check failed; re-verify liveness.
Nemzeti Cegtar gives entity resolution and ownership changes for HU PSPs/acquirers; queryable on demand.
Single Shopify app listing for SimplePay; useful adoption proxy but a leaf page of a marketplace, not standalone.
Szamlazz.hu/Shoprenter integration directories give a bottom-up census of PSP reach into HU SMEs; mine periodically.
ACI IR newsroom carries named HU wins (OTP, Erste, Takarekinfo); URL verification failed so re-check before approving.
Euronet GCS mirror is a redundant historical archive; failed check and marginal added value over primary IR site.
Finastra newsroom is a standing feed for core-banking client confirmations touching RBI/Hungary.
Temenos press archive is the canonical detector for any future HU core-banking win; monitor even without a current hit.
Diebold Nixdorf case-study hub keeps producing named CEE bank references and is where a HU one would appear.
Raw q4cdn file store duplicates the DN newsroom, is unindexed and failed verification; low incremental value.
NCR Atleos newsroom covers the Budapest ATM plant and any HU ATMaaS win; ownership change makes it time-sensitive.
NCR Voyix newsroom needed only to disambiguate post-split entity ownership of HU relationships.
Finextra press wire mirrors vendor HU customer-win releases and is searchable by bank name — good redundancy feed.
Business Wire is the primary dated distribution copy of vendor HU announcements; failed check, re-verify (possible bot gate).
FeaturedCustomers aggregates vendor named install bases; mine once per vendor to spot HU entities.
AppsRunTheWorld install-base data is largely behind a paid wall and low-credibility; hypothesis-generation only.
ATM Marketplace vendor showcase republishes collateral; useful entry point but sponsored and derivative.
Thales payment-HSM partner/resource pages rarely name banks; mine partner lists once for HU supply hints.
Capsys is a named local AFR integrator for HU banks; registry profile plus corporate site is a key supplier-link source.
IBS Intelligence and peers restate vendor wins with added HU bank naming — solid corroboration feed.
The Paypers publishes HU-specific 'bank selects vendor' items, widening the vendor map beyond the seed list.
MindSpire HU consultancy blog occasionally names core-banking incumbents/shortlists; low volume, modest credibility.
